name: What is the difference between roof repair and roof replacement?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between roof repair and roof replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: Roof repair addresses specific, localized damage such as a small leak, a few missing shingles, or minor flashing issues. It's a cost-effective solution when the overall roof structure is sound and has significant remaining life. Roof replacement involves removing the old roofing material and installing an entirely new system. This is typically needed when damage is widespread, the roof has reached the end of its lifespan, or due to severe storm damage.
acceptedAnswer.description: Roof repair fixes specific, localized damage, while roof replacement involves installing an entirely new roofing system when damage is widespread or the roof is aged.
